items.headline: Small Craft Advisory issued September 6 at 2:57PM EDT until September 8 at 12:00AM EDT by NWS Newport/Morehead City NC
items.description:
* WHAT...Northeast winds 15 to 20 kt with gusts to 25 kt and seas
4 to 6 ft expected.

* WHERE...The coastal waters from Duck to Oregon Inlet.

* WHEN...From 2 AM Monday to midnight EDT Monday night.

* IMPACTS...Conditions will be hazardous to small craft.
items.instruction:
Inexperienced mariners, especially those operating smaller
vessels, should avoid navigating in hazardous conditions.
